claims.result: Seven ULIRGs show signatures attributed to spatially resolved outflows.
claims.finding: Spherical-shell geometry is naturally explained by spatially resolved outflows.

claims.hypothesis: Elevated-ratio spaxels trace particular velocity components of molecular outflows.
claims.experiment: Compare PPV shell velocity separations with published maximum outflow velocities.
claims.result: Five ULIRGs show elevated ratios in modest-velocity outflow components.
claims.finding: The detected elevated ratios tend to probe modest velocities; high-velocity elevation is not excluded.

claims.result: Nine nuclei admit AGN and/or spatially confined outflow interpretations.

claims.hypothesis: Spectrally and spatially resolved ratios can clarify the physical origin of integrated ratio elevation.

claims.finding: PPV analysis provides additional diagnostic information, with limits from absorption and sensitivity.

limitations_admitted.value: High-velocity outflow components may be too faint for the PPV selection.
